title: Law360 reports Travis Lenkner's promotion to Chief Development Officer
summary: Law360 reports that Burford Capital has promoted Chief Development Officer Travis Lenkner to Chief Operating Officer, expanding his role overseeing execution and operating performance across the business. The article also notes the promotion of Carrie Tendler to Managing Director and Head of Asset Recovery, as Burford continues to build out its senior leadership team. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Law360 reports that Burford Capital has promoted Chief Development Officer[Travis Lenkner](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/travis-lenkner/) to Chief Operating Officer, expanding his role overseeing execution and operating performance across the business. The article also notes the promotion of[Carrie Tendler](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/carrie-tendler/) to Managing Director and Head of Asset Recovery, as Burford continues to build out its senior leadership team.


Read the full article[here](https://www.law360.com/articles/2475342/burford-capital-taps-development-chief-to-take-on-coo-role) .
